candidates.description: This feature activates on backslashes, curly braces, and other forward-slash or formatting punctuation characters used in code syntax.
This vector activates on mathematical symbols, punctuation, and LaTeX formatting tokens used in equations and expressions.
This vector activates on Thai script characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens.
This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) and related Thai character sequences containing it.
Mathematical symbols, operators, and LaTeX formatting commands.
This vector represents punctuation marks, parentheses, and comma characters often used in syntax or formatting.
This vector activates on closing curly brackets and parentheses, often accompanied by punctuation marks used in code syntax.
This feature vector activates on mixed-script character sequences and word fragments, particularly involving pseudonyms, hashing terms, and multilingual text segments.
This vector activates on mathematical operators, variables, and Greek letters commonly used in equations.
This feature vector represents Greek letters and their English phonetic spellings.
